2616|2|10|800.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
2616|2|10|800.evidence: USI median +0.336 over 101 corners (72 understeer, 9 mid-corner front reds)

2616|2|10|800.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
2616|2|10|800.evidence: 48/101 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

2616|2|10|800.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
2616|2|10|800.evidence: 42276 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

2616|2|10|800.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
2616|2|10|800.evidence: median peak rear slip 21.82; 1/1 launches spun

2616|2|10|800.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Fronts run 15 F+ hotter than rears: the understeer thermal signature — check pressures/camber on the HUD (Tires Misc + Heat).
2616|2|10|800.evidence: median F 211 F vs R 186 F

2616|2|10|800.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.46) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 16 stops (0 both-axle, 4 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
